Job Summary

Role: Snowflake Architects/Engineer (with Cortex AI)

Location: Pune/Hyd

Requirements
Must have skills: Snowflake, Snowflake Cortex AI (RAG, Semantic Search, Multi-agent systems), Capital Markets experience, Strong communication and client management skills
Nice to have skills: PostgreSQL, Talend, Azure or AWS, Denodo, Iceberg tables, Snowflake migration from legacy databases such as Oracle, DB2


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
